description: Existing approved CLS-047 from Cambridge Chapter 2 §16 presented unchanged truth conditions as invariant across information-packaging constructions; Chapter 16 §1 pp. 1365–1366 explicitly qualifies this because relative scope of many and negation can change truth conditions.
proposed_resolution: Approved and implemented: CLS-047 now says truth conditions and force are characteristically, not invariably, preserved. CLS-094 separately records the scope-sensitive exceptions. No blanket claim of semantic equivalence remains.
approval: User explicitly approved Chapter 16 changes in current request, November 5, 2026.
